transcript.text: Vaillant ecoTEC plus boiler showing F.28, no heating or hot water. It's freezing out. Should I take the front cover off and look?
Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it, what is it doing, and is anything showing on the display or control panel?

It's a gas combi boiler, a Vaillant ecoTEC plus 832, about 8 years old. It won't fire, display shows F.28 and I've got no heating or hot water since this morning after the hard frost. Fan runs and clicks a few times then stops. No gas smell.
To look up F.28 I need the make and the type of appliance — which brand is it, and is it a washing machine, dishwasher, oven or something else?
It's a Vaillant, a gas combi boiler (ecoTEC plus 832) - not a washing machine or anything like that. It's the central heating and hot water boiler.

Sorry — I still need the make and appliance type to look F.28 up, because the same code means different things on different brands. If you'd rather not say, tell me what the appliance is doing when the code shows and I'll help from that.
